mission.BramfaturaInvasion.after: Another descent completed. We need to process the quasimorphic samples we pulled from this bramfatura.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.briefing: We don’t know what might be waiting for you down there. You may evacuate at any moment if you feel your strength is fading. Magnum is ready to bring you aboard.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Descend into the bramfatura for profit.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> We are positioned above one of the bramfaturas. That means new opportunities for profit extraction. Corporations would call it resource requisition in a contested zone; the Civil Resistance would call it expropriation. For us, it’s simply lawful salvage. The primary objective of the operation is the <color=#FFFEC1>collection of artifacts</color> and other quasimorphic samples of market value. The secondary objective is to study the structure and laws of the bramfatura, provided it does not interfere with the main task.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.evacuation_al: Local telefaturic dislocation succeeded. The portal is open; you may evacuate.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.evacuation_in: The portal is open — evacuate to Magnum through it.
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage1.name: Twilight of Matters
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage10.name: Vestibule of the Antiworld
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage2.name: Limit of Forms
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage3.name: Ash Halls
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage4.name: Bloody Roots
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage5.name: Lightless Flame
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage6.name: Labyrinth of Mirrors
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage7.name: Rotting Heavens
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage8.name: Bones of Time
mission.BramfaturaInvasion.stage9.name: Cradle of Sin
mission.CEO_Eilimination.after: We're one step closer to the top of the market. Now %VICTIM_NAME% will scramble to reshuffle the vacant seats, and your proxy corporation will be ready to solidify its position. And you know what? Good move, boss.
mission.CEO_Eilimination.briefing: Scanners have already picked up the target's personal signature. It's marked on your map. %STATION_NAME% is heavily fortified — probably the toughest nut we've ever had to crack from %VICTIM_NAME%. The CEO is likely holed up in a secure sector of the station, and their entourage will put up fierce resistance, so gear up for a fight. Remember, looting %STATION_NAME% for valuables isn't our primary objective, but since our real goal is the corporation itself, consider their goods already ours.
mission.CEO_Eilimination.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Locate and eliminate the CEO of <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color>.
mission.CEO_Eilimination.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> How ironic — the PMCs were once corporate proxy armies. Looks like it's time to flip the script, eh? Now we're calling the shots, boss — we’re the client, contractor, and beneficiary all rolled into one. By installing the proxy corporation control module onto the Magnum, we've taken our first step to dominating the market. But first, we need to create a vacancy. The CEO of <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> is the linchpin — the only one left standing in the way of our direct control. Taking them out will send the market into chaos. While their stocks tank, we'll have just enough breathing room to neatly plug our control module into the corporation and seize the reins from the board of directors. This mission requires absolute precision. We'll need a surgical infiltration of the %STATION_NAME%: get in, pinpoint the target, eliminate them, and slip away quietly. After that, Magnum's analytics center will handle the rest.
mission.CEO_Eilimination.objective0: This isn't just a job — it's a business strategy. Your target: the CEO, the head of %VICTIM_NAME%. Far too much depends on them to leave them breathing.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Control1.after: Excellent work, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. The colnodes have prepared and shipped valuable cargo to the Magnum as your reward.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Control1.brief: We’ve decoded the sensor data and marked the cargo location on your map. Saboteur teams will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they breach the orbital defenses. Eliminate them all and <color=#FFFEC1>don’t let the cargo be destroyed</color>.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Control1.detai: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> The remnants of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> — <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color> and <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> — hate each other just as much as they hate the corporations. A group of colnodes holding %STATION_NAME% has requested our assistance in protecting a resource stockpile. For some reason, <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> is determined to destroy it, sparing no effort or resources.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Control1.objec: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>defend the stockpile</color> belonging to <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color>. It’s a pile of crates. You’ve seen plenty of those in the cargo bay of the Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Defense1.after: The rebels have retained control of %STATION_NAME%. Direct action has proven to be a losing strategy for <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color>. Which means the traitors will now switch to assassinations, espionage, and sabotage. In other words, more job for us soon. For now, a shipment from the rebels has arrived aboard the Magnum as thanks for defending the station.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Defense1.brief: We need to <color=#FFFEC1>hold the line</color> and endure until the enemy gives up on storming the station. Remember, colnodes feel no pity for themselves — they can attack relentlessly. It might not be easy. Collateral damage shouldn't concern us. We have one mission: by the time the dust settles and the smoke clears, %STATION_NAME% must still be in the hands of <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color>.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Defense1.detai:
Details: Looks like %VICTIM_NAME% is launching an operation to wipe out %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. Wow, Boss, that's not even funny. %STATION_NAME% is currently the target of so-called "direct action" by those who claim to be the true heirs of the Revolution. Yes, we’re talking about a hostile takeover.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% is broadcasting reward offers for anyone willing to help defend %STATION_NAME%. Simple task: we deploy at the coordinates provided by the client and eliminate the attackers until they retreat.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Elimination1.a: Another traitor to the working class has been eliminated. And so it will be for everyone who dares defy the will of the people! Colnodes of <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color> have delivered the promised reward to the Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Elimination1.b: We’ve received the target's personal signature. Our sensors clearly identify the commander among the rest of the personnel on %STATION_NAME%. The colnodes may put up solid resistance — or they might scatter. Not everyone has realized yet who they should stand with — Issachar or Leah. <color=#FFFEC1>Eliminate the target and return</color>. Try not to get too distracted exploring %STATION_NAME%, that’s not part of our priority.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Elimination1.d: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Locate and eliminate the key colnode of the traitorous faction.

Details: The Solar System is gripped by anarcho-capitalism that driven by NCE. However, groups outside the ancap system live in true hell.

Currently, %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of a remnants of the Civil Resistance, known as %VICTIM_NAME%. The commander of this seditious group is notorious for his hatred of the true ideals of the Revolution. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% requests our assistance in carrying out a punitive operation against the traitor.

Eliminating this experienced key colnode will send a clear message to all colnodes of %VICTIM_NAME% — it’s not too late to choose the right side in the new Civil War.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Elimination1.o: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> The key colnode of the traitorous faction. He’ll fight for his life as fiercely as for his revolution.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Escort1.after: <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color> is extremely grateful for saving the life of an experienced commander. The colnode supervising the reward shipment to the Magnum creeped me out even more than usual. I really don’t like working with them.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Escort1.briefi: The target’s signature has been marked on your map by the colnodes. Escort the commander to the designated safe zone aboard %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you're clear. Colnodes are hard to tell apart, so stay sharp. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not part of the mission — but if you spot something valuable, use your judgement.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the <color=#FFFEC1>comnode</color> to a safe location.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Escort1.detail:
Details: %STATION_NAME% has long been under the control of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rebels have established one of their field headquarters here to systematically harass all enemies of the working class in this part of the Solar System. Naturally, this doesn’t sit well with corporations or pirate crews. But most of all, it infuriates the traitors from %VICTIM_NAME%.

They’ve issued a private military contract to eliminate the comnode commander stationed on %STATION_NAME%. We can take a contract from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to protect him. Not the most glorious work, but a solid way to strengthen relations with the rebels.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Escort1.object: Escort duty is routine work. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: deliver the colnode commander to the safe zone designated by <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color>.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Espionage1.aft:
%VICTIM_NAME% is urgently changing all plans concerning %STATION_NAME%. The new Civil War is burning hotter than ever, and %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already broadcasting statements claiming responsibility for the strike. If %VICTIM_NAME% decides to retaliate, we might even take a job from them next time.

The contact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has secured the PCPU and delivered our reward — it's already aboard the spacecraft.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Espionage1.bri: Our sensors have located a <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> packed with data. However, the colnodes aboard %STATION_NAME% are already on high alert. We’ll drop you as close to the objective as possible. <color=#FFFEC1>Grab the device and get out</color>. Only get distracted if the risk is truly worth it.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Espionage1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Retrieve the traitors’ <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Espionage1.det: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Recently, %STATION_NAME% has become the main operational hub for the traitorous faction <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color>. Numerous raids launched from here have targeted the true revolutionary organization <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color>. The rebels could use some insight into the traitors' future plans. That can be arranged: we infiltrate %STATION_NAME%, locate the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> loaded with their plans, and <color=#FFFEC1>%BENEFICIARY_NAME%</color> will have no choice but to trade us something valuable for it.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Espionage1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Retrieve the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> with intel on <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> activities from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
<color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> is now forced to look for another way to uncover the plans of the true heirs of the Revolution. We’ve already received our reward, but it seems the events surrounding this station are only just beginning to escalate.
We need to prevent any breach of %STATION_NAME% by destroying all traitor colnode squads. I believe in you, but be careful.

Details: Recently, %STATION_NAME% has become the primary operational hub for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in their fight against %VICTIM_NAME%. The colnodes have learned that agents of %VICTIM_NAME% have identified this location and are preparing a covert operation. Their target is a PCPU containing critical data. If the device is stolen, the rebels will have to rewrite all operational and strategic plans.

If we want to earn the reward for this contract, we must eliminate all infiltration teams coming after the PCPU.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1: <color=#FFFEC1>%VICTIM_NAME%</color> is furious. The rebels have lost a strategically valuable station for establishing a supply hub in the new Civil War. Clones have already delivered our reward to the Magnum for participating in the true liberation of the working class.

Landing in 10 seconds. Once the station defenders realize the battle is lost, they’ll retreat or surrender. You only need to eliminate 50% of the combatants.

Keep an eye on the indicators! If you think you have the strength and resources, you can explore the station. But officially, the contract only covers the capture — the client will take %STATION_NAME% in any condition. The remnants of the Civil Resistance don’t care about the appearance of the property.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate <color=#FFFEC1>50% of the defenders</color> of station %STATION_NAME%.

Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is taking advantage of the chaos of the new Civil War. Rebels have launched sabotage, assassinations, and espionage operations against both old and new enemies of the working class across the Solar System.

%STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called “direct action” — meaning seizure. That’s where we come in.

Simple task: We go in, eliminate anyone capable of holding a weapon, and get out before the place turns into another branch of hell. Colnodes from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will handle station defense after we leave.%VICTIM_NAME% has already dispatched all available combat groups to defend %STATION_NAME%.

Oh, almost forgot. Seizing stations pays well. And building trust with comrades from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% never hurts.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Sabotage1.afte: Excellent work, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. Colnodes have prepared and shipped valuable cargo to the Magnum as your reward.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Sabotage1.brie: We have marked the locations of the stockpiles on your map. Do not expect to be dropped too close to them. The stockpiles are well hidden deep within %STATION_NAME%. You need to locate and <color=#FFFEC1>destroy several piles of crates</color>. You are allowed to deviate from the main task only if you find something truly important.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the resource stockpile of the traitorous faction on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Sabotage1.deta:
Details: Unfortunately, it’s not just corporations and pirates oppressing the working class. Traitors who’ve lost their revolutionary instincts have formed the criminal gang %VICTIM_NAME%. They are squandering human potential in vain.

Right now, these scum have organized a resource stockpile on %STATION_NAME%. A contact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is offering us a contract to destroy that stockpile — so some of the traitors might reconsider whether %VICTIM_NAME% is really providing them with the protection they need. If people have nothing to eat, maybe they’ll side with the true Revolution. Good thing the recruitment center isn’t far from here.
mission.CivilRes_CivilRes_Sabotage1.obje: Your task is to locate and <color=#FFFEC1>destroy several stockpiles</color>. A stockpile is a pile of crates. You have seen such piles many times in the cargo bay of the Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Control1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is already spreading information about its unprecedented success in the fight against terrorism. Of course, they cannot provide evidence. This is why the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> will win sooner or later. The ancap system needs to feed less on its own propaganda.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Control1.briefing: The location of the supply depot is marked on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them and don’t let them destroy what they earned with such difficulty.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Control1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the supply warehouse of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Control1.details:
Details: the Civil Resistance has strengthened its position at %STATION_NAME%. The comrades carried out several successful operations against the capitalists from here. However, the latest raid on %VICTIM_NAME% was a mistake. Corporation analysts tracked the raiders' path to %STATION_NAME%. And now the CR is preparing for defense. We must prevent corporate henchmen from destroying the resources collected here.

If we help the rebels protect the supplies, we will not only receive their respect, but also some of the salvaged equipment.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Control1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the supply warehouse of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Defense1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is conducting a massive information campaign to save its reputation after a failed attack on %STATION_NAME%. The reward from comrades from the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is already on board Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Defense1.briefing: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. Most of the equipment here is stuff taken from corporations. If you take something for yourself, the colnodes won't mind. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out</color> as long as possible, the onslaught of the mercenaries will certainly weaken.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: The time has come to speak out against the oppressors of the working people. Today we will not allow those who deprived us of our Motherland to take away %STATION_NAME%.

%VICTIM_NAME% is actively posting messages in the SBN about the inadmissibility of further stay of terrorists of the Civil Resistance at the station. This is a signal for us and other honest citizens of the Solar System.

The task is simple: take a defensive position and kill as many corporate mercenaries as possible, discouraging them from seizing the station.

When the job is done, %STATION_NAME% will be free from capitalist oppression. Our comrades promise to reward our efforts well.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Elimination1.after:
The capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% began an information campaign about the need to completely eradicate terrorism in the System. They may want to strike back in retaliation. Why don't we take on this job then?

A group of colnodes delivered a reward to Magnum for the work done. Fortunately, they have already set sail: looking into their empty eyes can be unbearable.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Elimination1.brief: Good news: the target is at %STATION_NAME%. Moderate resistance is expected from the <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service</color> of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% or the <color=#FFFEC1>PMCs</color> working for them. There's no difference, is there? <color=#FFFEC1>If you eliminate the target, come back</color>. And try not to get too distracted by exploring %STATION_NAME%, this is not our priority task.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the high-ranking manager of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Elimination1.detai:
Details: People from the Civil Resistance contacted us. Comrades say that the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% have recently particularly distinguished themselves in the field of oppression of the working class.

So, one of their satraps is organizing an attack on the liberated CR stations and colonies. They are currently located at %STATION_NAME%. We can help the rebels by eliminating this person. At the same time, let's test the strength of the defense of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%.

Do not burden yourself with the responsibility for the fight against the anarcho-capitalist regime of the System, Boss. Let's work for a reward: the warehouses of the CR are full of goods expropriated from corporations.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Elimination1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the high-ranking manager of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Escort1.after: Let everyone see that %VICTIM_NAME% is not able to eliminate the colnode, that it is losing its grip. I wouldn’t be surprised if we soon stumble upon an order against the capitalist %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Escort1.briefing: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>escort the key colnode</color> to the location marked on the map.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has long held %STATION_NAME%. This place is a bastion of struggle against corporate oppressors. However, this is precisely what attracted the attention of %VICTIM_NAME%. It prepared an operation to eliminate the <color=#FFFEC1>key colnode</color> - one of the commanders of the <color=#FFFEC1>CR</color>. We can help our comrades in their fight if we escort them to the safe location at %STATION_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Escort1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Espionage1.after: The exchange took place. The colnodes of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> left us some property. We exchange the worst for the bad, of course, but this is honest work.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Espionage1.briefin: %STATION_NAME% has an unusual signature. 99.9% probability that this is the prototype needed by the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. We'll drop you off as close to your target as possible. Make your way through the security, <color=#FFFEC1>take the device, and return</color>. If you decide to look for something unusual at %STATION_NAME%, make sure it's worth the risk.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the prototype of the new invention at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
